Methods We conducted a descriptive two-centre case series of confirmed LF cases identified at the University of Port Harcourt Teaching Hospital (UPTH) and Rivers State University Teaching Hospital (RSUTH) from January 23 to August 13, 2024. One survivor with severe renal disease required six haemodialysis sessions and was discharged after 18 days.
